nativeBaseline.reference: authored header, navigation, main, and footer landmarks/regions

library: provide semantic application-region composition without inventing router or policy semantics
preserve source order, native landmark behavior, logical layout, and visible focus styling
consumer: author meaningful navigation landmark names and application content
own route/history/title focus policy, authentication, authorization, privacy, data, and workflow state

notes: AppShell is structural composition; interactive descendants own their own accessibility and assistive-technology requirements.
Application route changes may deliberately move focus, while local updates must not reuse route-level focus behavior.
